content.Title: Recommended Monitoring for Patients Taking Other Antiarrhythmic Drugs

Drugs.Name: Dofetilide
Drugs.Baseline Testing: 12-lead ECG, continuous electrocardiographic monitoring during 3-day hospitalization for dofetilide initiation, serum potassium and magnesium concentration, serum creatinine for estimation of CrCl
Drugs.Follow-Up Testing: In 3-6 months: 12-lead ECG, serum potassium and magnesium concentration, serum creatinine for estimation of CrCl
Drugs.Additional Follow-Up Testing: Every 3-6 months (more frequently for patients concomitantly taking other QT interval-prolonging drugs or with changing kidney function): 12-lead ECG, serum potassium and magnesium concentration, serum creatinine for estimation of CrCl

Drugs.Name: Ibutilide
Drugs.Baseline Testing: 12-lead ECG, determination of serum potassium and magnesium concentrations and correction of hypokalemia and/or hypomagnesemia is recommended before initiation of the infusion
Drugs.Follow-Up Testing: Continuous electrocardiographic monitoring for assessment of QTc interval duration is recommended for at least 4 hours after infusion or until the QTc has returned to baseline to minimize the risk of ibutilide-associated TdP

Drugs.Name: Procainamide
Drugs.Follow-Up Testing: Electrocardiographic monitoring for assessment of rhythm, QRS width and QTc interval is recommended during the infusion to minimize the risk of procainamide-associated ventricular proarrhythmia, including TdP. BP monitoring is recommended during the infusion to detect clinically relevant hypotension

Drugs.Name: Sotalol
Drugs.Baseline Testing: 12-lead ECG, continuous electrocardiographic monitoring during 3-day hospitalization for sotalol initiation, serum potassium and magnesium concentration, serum creatinine for estimation of CrCl
Drugs.Follow-Up Testing: In 3-6 months: 12-lead ECG, serum potassium and magnesium concentration, serum creatinine for estimation of CrCl
Drugs.Additional Follow-Up Testing: Every 3-6 months (more frequently for patients concomitantly taking other QT interval-prolonging drugs or with changing kidney function): 12-lead ECG, serum potassium and magnesium concentration, serum creatinine for estimation of CrCl
